name: scoutbox-gleam-server-e2e
description: Runs the TypeScript server's end-to-end batteries against the Gleam server. No dependencies.

scripts.e2e:check: node e2e/sync.mjs --check && node dev/migrations_sql.mjs --check && node dev/battery_cases.mjs --check && node dev/combine_protocols.mjs --check && node dev/ledger.mjs --check
scripts.codegen: gleam dev && gleam format src/scoutbox/rows src/scoutbox/vocab
scripts.codegen:check: rm -rf build/codegen-check && gleam dev build/codegen-check && gleam format build/codegen-check && diff -r build/codegen-check/scoutbox/rows src/scoutbox/rows && diff -r build/codegen-check/scoutbox/vocab src/scoutbox/vocab
